description.purpose: The resend watchdog of ./push (R-AG-1, GH #1096). It carries no schedule of its own: ./push keeps one one-shot named `affinity-push` under a fixed id and re-arms it (`rearm`) for the earliest unconfirmed pack.
description.use_when: Inside the affinity hive, always. It is not a poll (GH #553): with every pack confirmed it orders nothing and stays silent; a change reaches ./push from ./gate, not from here.
description.not_in_scope: No cron, no change detection -- the write is the event.
description.emits_meaning: A plain strike, schedule_name `affinity-push`, which is what the hive's edge recognises. A refused order leaves as `timer_op_error` and the hive's edge carries it to ./push.
description.consumes_meaning: Schedule ops (add/modify/remove by schedule_id) as body.op -- in practice the one `add` with `rearm` that ./push sends.
examples: a pack sent at 10:00 and not confirmed -> one strike at 10:05 -> ./push sends it again and arms 10:15
